sourceContext.originPage: ESG landing page - 'three foundational pillars' section

contentPattern.structure: three equal-width columns, each an image above a short bold-labelled caption paragraph (no CTAs)

suitableFor: equal-width image + short caption column rows (3-up pillars)
value/pillar showcases pairing a photo with a one-line label and description
simple multi-column image+text layouts without CTAs or intro column
notSuitableFor: image + eyebrow + heading + CTA feature layouts (use columns-feature)
intro column beside a multi-item feature grid (use columns-patient)
distinct repeatable cards with their own CTAs (use cards)
